summary.reason_ui_not_relevant: The slice changed Nuclei runner dispatch, run-profile metadata, command preview text, and evidence artifacts; no operator-console UI rendering or browser workflow was changed.
summary.safety_boundary: Detection-only. No RCE exploitation, webshell upload, persistence, file write, or shell execution path was added.

implemented_controls: active-web-rce-nuclei-audit profile is approval-gated and separate from passive-web-nuclei-audit
passive-web-nuclei-audit remains the existing passive-safe pinned baseline
runner can perform governed nuclei -update-templates only when task params include update_templates and template_update_approved
runner emits nuclei-rce-plan.json with candidate template ids, selected safe ids, blocked ids, OOB status, update status, repository status, and service evidence samples
runner disables Interactsh with -no-interactsh unless oob_enabled is true and interactsh_server is explicitly configured
service-aware selection maps existing inventory/service evidence such as Jenkins, Grafana, Druid, Spring, GeoServer, Log4j, Bludit, Samba, and Drupal to CVE template ids

official local CVE templates are filtered before execution when they contain raw requests, payload keys, JavaScript/code protocol, command execution strings, JNDI/Interactsh callbacks, or outbound curl payloads

focused: source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest api/tests/test_nuclei_dispatch.py workers/tests/test_runner_contract.py workers/tests/test_nuclei_rce_runner.py api/tests/test_runs.py::test_list_run_profiles api/tests/test_runs.py::test_active_rce_nuclei_profile_requires_approval_and_queues_service_aware_task -q

source .venv/bin/activate && ruff check workers/runners/nuclei/runner.py workers/runners/nuclei/rce_catalog.py workers/tests/test_nuclei_rce_runner.py api/app/services/runs.py api/app/services/run_profiles.py api/tests/test_runs.py workers/orchestration/tasks.py

remaining_gaps: No live AutoPenBench WS5/WS6 target was scanned in this build-lane task.
